031/**
032 * Encapsulates Java system properties with support for global and per-thread overrides for unit testing.
033 *
034 * <p>
035 * This class provides a thread-safe way to access system properties that can be overridden at both the global level
036 * and per-thread level, making it useful for unit tests that need to temporarily change system property
037 * values without affecting other tests or threads.
038 *
039 * <p>
040 * Settings instances are created using the {@link Builder} pattern. Use {@link #create()} to create a new builder,
041 * or {@link #get()} to get the singleton instance (which is created using default builder settings).
042 *
043 * <h5 class='section'>Lookup Order:</h5>
044 * <p>
045 * When retrieving a property value, the lookup order is:
046 * <ol>
047 *    <li>Per-thread store (if set via {@link #setLocal(String, String)})
048 *    <li>Global store (if set via {@link #setGlobal(String, String)})
049 *    <li>Sources in reverse order (last source added via {@link Builder#addSource(PropertySource)} is checked first)
050 *    <li>System property source (default, always second-to-last)
051 *    <li>System environment variable source (default, always last)
052 * </ol>
053 *
054 * <h5 class='section'>Sources vs Stores:</h5>
055 * <ul class='spaced-list'>
056 *    <li><b>Sources</b> ({@link PropertySource}) - Provide read-only access to property values. Examples: {@link FunctionalPropertySource}
057 *    <li><b>Stores</b> ({@link PropertyStore}) - Provide read/write access to property values. Examples: {@link MapStore}, {@link FunctionalPropertyStore}
058 *    <li>Stores can be used as sources (they extend {@link PropertySource}), so you can add stores via {@link Builder#addSource(PropertySource)}
059 * </ul>
060 *
061 * <h5 class='section'>Features:</h5>
062 * <ul class='spaced-list'>
063 *    <li>System property access - read Java system properties with type conversion via {@link StringSetting}
064 *    <li>Global overrides - override system properties globally for all threads (stored in a {@link PropertyStore})
065 *    <li>Per-thread overrides - override system properties for specific threads (stored in a per-thread {@link PropertyStore})
066 *    <li>Custom sources - add arbitrary property sources (e.g., Spring properties, environment variables, config files) via the {@link Builder}
067 *    <li>Disable override support - system property to prevent new global overrides from being set
068 *    <li>Type-safe accessors - type conversion methods on {@link StringSetting} for common types: Integer, Long, Boolean, Double, Float, File, Path, URI, Charset
069 *    <li>Resettable suppliers - settings are returned as {@link StringSetting} instances that can be reset to force recomputation
070 * </ul>
071 *
072 * <h5 class='section'>Usage Examples:</h5>
073 * <p class='bjava'>
074 *    <jc>// Get a system property as a StringSetting (using singleton instance)</jc>
075 *    StringSetting <jv>setting</jv> = Settings.<jsf>get</jsf>().get(<js>"my.property"</js>);
076 *    String <jv>value</jv> = <jv>setting</jv>.get();  <jc>// Get the string value</jc>
077 *
078 *    <jc>// Get with type conversion using StringSetting methods</jc>
079 *    Setting&lt;Integer&gt; <jv>intSetting</jv> = Settings.<jsf>get</jsf>().get(<js>"my.int.property"</js>).asInteger();
080 *    Setting&lt;Long&gt; <jv>longSetting</jv> = Settings.<jsf>get</jsf>().get(<js>"my.long.property"</js>).asLong();
081 *    Setting&lt;Boolean&gt; <jv>boolSetting</jv> = Settings.<jsf>get</jsf>().get(<js>"my.bool.property"</js>).asBoolean();
082 *    Setting&lt;Double&gt; <jv>doubleSetting</jv> = Settings.<jsf>get</jsf>().get(<js>"my.double.property"</js>).asDouble();
083 *    Setting&lt;Float&gt; <jv>floatSetting</jv> = Settings.<jsf>get</jsf>().get(<js>"my.float.property"</js>).asFloat();
084 *    Setting&lt;File&gt; <jv>fileSetting</jv> = Settings.<jsf>get</jsf>().get(<js>"my.file.property"</js>).asFile();
085 *    Setting&lt;Path&gt; <jv>pathSetting</jv> = Settings.<jsf>get</jsf>().get(<js>"my.path.property"</js>).asPath();
086 *    Setting&lt;URI&gt; <jv>uriSetting</jv> = Settings.<jsf>get</jsf>().get(<js>"my.uri.property"</js>).asURI();
087 *    Setting&lt;Charset&gt; <jv>charsetSetting</jv> = Settings.<jsf>get</jsf>().get(<js>"my.charset.property"</js>).asCharset();
088 *
089 *    <jc>// Use custom type conversion</jc>
090 *    Setting&lt;MyCustomType&gt; <jv>customSetting</jv> = Settings.<jsf>get</jsf>().get(<js>"my.custom.property"</js>).asType(MyCustomType.<jk>class</jk>);
091 *
092 *    <jc>// Reset a setting to force recomputation</jc>
093 *    <jv>setting</jv>.reset();
094 *
095 *    <jc>// Override for current thread (useful in unit tests)</jc>
096 *    Settings.<jsf>get</jsf>().setLocal(<js>"my.property"</js>, <js>"test-value"</js>);
097 *    <jc>// ... test code that uses the override ...</jc>
098 *    Settings.<jsf>get</jsf>().unsetLocal(<js>"my.property"</js>);  <jc>// Remove specific override</jc>
099 *    <jc>// OR</jc>
100 *    Settings.<jsf>get</jsf>().clearLocal();  <jc>// Clear all thread-local overrides</jc>
101 *
102 *    <jc>// Set global override (applies to all threads)</jc>
103 *    Settings.<jsf>get</jsf>().setGlobal(<js>"my.property"</js>, <js>"global-value"</js>);
104 *    <jc>// ... code that uses the global override ...</jc>
105 *    Settings.<jsf>get</jsf>().unsetGlobal(<js>"my.property"</js>);  <jc>// Remove specific override</jc>
106 *    <jc>// OR</jc>
107 *    Settings.<jsf>get</jsf>().clearGlobal();  <jc>// Clear all global overrides</jc>
108 *
109 *    <jc>// Create a custom Settings instance with custom sources (e.g., Spring properties)</jc>
110 *    MapStore <jv>springSource</jv> = <jk>new</jk> MapStore();
111 *    <jv>springSource</jv>.set(<js>"spring.datasource.url"</js>, <js>"jdbc:postgresql://localhost/db"</js>);
112 *    Settings <jv>custom</jv> = Settings.<jsf>create</jsf>()
113 *       .addSource(<jv>springSource</jv>)
114 *       .addSource(FunctionalPropertySource.<jsf>of</jsf>(System::getProperty))
115 *       .build();
116 * </p>
117 *
118 * <h5 class='section'>System Properties:</h5>
119 * <ul class='spaced-list'>
120 *    <li><c>juneau.settings.disableGlobal</c> (system property) or <c>JUNEAU_SETTINGS_DISABLEGLOBAL</c> (system env) - If set to <c>true</c>, prevents new global overrides
121 *       from being set via {@link #setGlobal(String, String)}. Existing global overrides will still be
122 *       returned by {@link #get(String)} until explicitly removed.
123 *       <p class='bnote'>
124 *          Note: This property is read once at class initialization time when creating the singleton instance
125 *          and cannot be changed at runtime. Changing the system property after the class has been loaded will
126 *          have no effect on the singleton instance. However, you can create custom Settings instances using
127 *          {@link #create()} that ignore this property.
128 *       </p>
129 * </ul>
130 */
131@SuppressWarnings({
132   "java:S115", // Constants use UPPER_snakeCase convention (e.g., MSG_globalDisabled)
133   "java:S1192", // Duplicated literals (argument/property names) read more clearly inline than as constants
134   "unchecked" // Type erasure requires unchecked cast
135})
136public class Settings {
137
138   /**
139    * System property source that delegates to {@link System#getProperty(String)}.
140    */
141   public static final PropertySource SYSTEM_PROPERTY_SOURCE = FunctionalPropertySource.of(System::getProperty);
142
143   private static final Set<String> FROM_STRING_METHOD_NAMES = new LinkedHashSet<>(Arrays.asList("fromString", "parse", "forName", "valueOf"));
144
145   /**
146    * System environment variable source that delegates to {@link System#getenv(String)}.
147    */
148   public static final PropertySource SYSTEM_ENV_SOURCE = FunctionalPropertySource.of(System::getenv);
149
150   /**
151    * {@link #SYSTEM_ENV_SOURCE} wrapped with {@link RelaxedPropertySource relaxed binding}, so a single logical key
152    * resolves from any of the common environment-variable spellings (e.g. {@code my.prop} / {@code myProp} /
153    * {@code MySection/myKey} all satisfied by {@code MY_PROP} / {@code MY_SECTION_MY_KEY}).
154    *
155    * <p>
156    * This is the env source used by the default {@link #get() singleton}.  It is verbatim-first, so exact-match
157    * behavior is unchanged &mdash; a relaxed variant is only probed when the exact name misses.
158    *
159    * @since 10.0.0
160    */
161   public static final PropertySource RELAXED_SYSTEM_ENV_SOURCE = new RelaxedPropertySource(SYSTEM_ENV_SOURCE);
162
163   private static final String DISABLE_GLOBAL_PROP = "juneau.settings.disableGlobal";
164   private static final String MSG_globalDisabled = "Global settings not enabled";
165   private static final String MSG_localDisabled = "Local settings not enabled";
166
167   /**
168    * Returns properties for this Settings object itself.
169    * Note that these are initialized at startup and not changeable through System.setProperty().
170    */
171   private static final Optional<String> initProperty(String property) {
172      var v = SYSTEM_PROPERTY_SOURCE.get(property);
173      if (v.isPresent())
174         return v.value();  // Not testable
175      v = SYSTEM_ENV_SOURCE.get(ucr(property.replace('.', '_')));
176      if (v.isPresent())
177         return v.value();  // Not testable
178      return oe();
179   }
180
181   /**
182    * Creates a new builder for constructing a Settings instance.
183    *
184    * <p>
185    * This method provides a convenient way to create custom Settings instances with specific
186    * configuration. The builder allows you to configure stores, sources, and other settings
187    * before building the final Settings instance.
188    *
189    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
190    * <p class='bjava'>
191    *    <jc>// Create a custom Settings instance</jc>
192    *    Settings <jv>custom</jv> = Settings.<jsf>create</jsf>()
193    *       .globalStore(() -&gt; <jk>new</jk> MapStore())
194    *       .localStore(() -&gt; <jk>new</jk> MapStore())
195    *       .addSource(FunctionalPropertySource.<jsf>of</jsf>(System::getProperty))
196    *       .build();
197    * </p>
198    *
199    * @return A new Builder instance.
200    */
201   public static Builder create() {
202      return new Builder();
203   }
204
205   /**
206    * Builder for creating Settings instances.
207    */
208   public static class Builder {
209      private Supplier<PropertyStore> globalStoreSupplier = MapStore::new;
210      private Supplier<PropertyStore> localStoreSupplier = MapStore::new;
211      private final List<PropertySource> sources = new ArrayList<>();
212      private final Map<Class<?>,Function<String,?>> customTypeFunctions = new IdentityHashMap<>();
213
214      /**
215       * Sets the supplier for the global store.
216       *
217       * @param supplier The supplier for the global store.  Must not be <c>null</c>.  Can supply null to disable global store.
218       * @return This builder for method chaining.
219       */
220      public Builder globalStore(NullableSupplier<PropertyStore> supplier) {
221         this.globalStoreSupplier = reqnn("supplier", supplier);
222         return this;
223      }
224
225      /**
226       * Sets the supplier for the local (per-thread) store.
227       *
228       * @param supplier The supplier for the local store. Must not be <c>null</c>.
229       * @return This builder for method chaining.
230       */
231      public Builder localStore(NullableSupplier<PropertyStore> supplier) {
232         this.localStoreSupplier = reqnn("supplier", supplier);
233         return this;
234      }
235
236      /**
237       * Sets the sources list, replacing any existing sources.
238       *
239       * @param sources The sources to set. Must not be <c>null</c> or contain <c>null</c> elements.
240       * @return This builder for method chaining.
241       */
242      @SafeVarargs
243      public final Builder setSources(PropertySource...sources) {
244         reqnns("sources", sources);
245         this.sources.clear();
246         for (var source : sources) {
247            this.sources.add(source);
248         }
249         return this;
250      }
251
252      /**
253       * Adds a source to the sources list.
254       *
255       * @param source The source to add. Must not be <c>null</c>.
256       * @return This builder for method chaining.
257       */
258      public Builder addSource(PropertySource source) {
259         reqnn("source", source);
260         this.sources.add(source);
261         return this;
262      }
263
264      /**
265       * Adds a functional source to the sources list.
266       *
267       * @param source The functional source to add. Must not be <c>null</c>.
268       * @return This builder for method chaining.
269       */
270      public Builder addSource(FunctionalPropertySource source) {
271         return addSource((PropertySource)source);
272      }
273
274      /**
275       * Discovers and registers {@link PropertySourceProvider} instances via {@link ServiceLoader}.
276       *
277       * <p>
278       * Providers are sorted by {@link PropertySourceProvider#order()} ascending.
279       *
280       * @return This builder for method chaining.
281       */
282      public Builder useServiceLoader() {
283         ServiceLoader.load(PropertySourceProvider.class)
284            .stream()
285            .map(ServiceLoader.Provider::get)
286            .sorted(Comparator.comparingInt(PropertySourceProvider::order))
287            .map(PropertySourceProvider::create)
288            .filter(Objects::nonNull)
289            .forEach(this::addSource);
290         return this;
291      }
292
293      /**
294       * Registers a custom type conversion function for the specified type.
295       *
296       * <p>
297       * This allows you to add support for converting string values to custom types when using
298       * {@link Settings#get(String, Object)}. The function will be used to convert string values
299       * to the specified type.
300       *
301       * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
302       * <p class='bjava'>
303       *    <jc>// Register a custom converter for a custom type</jc>
304       *    Settings <jv>custom</jv> = Settings.<jsf>create</jsf>()
305       *       .addTypeFunction(Integer.<jk>class</jk>, Integer::valueOf)
306       *       .addTypeFunction(MyCustomType.<jk>class</jk>, MyCustomType::fromString)
307       *       .build();
308       *
309       *    <jc>// Now you can use get() with these types</jc>
310       *    Integer <jv>intValue</jv> = <jv>custom</jv>.get(<js>"my.int.property"</js>, 0);
311       *    MyCustomType <jv>customValue</jv> = <jv>custom</jv>.get(<js>"my.custom.property"</js>, MyCustomType.DEFAULT);
312       * </p>
313       *
314       * @param <T> The type to register a converter for.
315       * @param type The class type to register a converter for. Must not be <c>null</c>.
316       * @param function The function that converts a string to the specified type. Must not be <c>null</c>.
317       * @return This builder for method chaining.
318       */
319      public <T> Builder addTypeFunction(Class<T> type, Function<String,T> function) {
320         reqnn("type", type);
321         reqnn("function", function);
322         customTypeFunctions.put(type, function);
323         return this;
324      }
325
326      /**
327       * Builds a Settings instance from this builder.
328       *
329       * @return A new Settings instance.
330       */
331      public Settings build() {
332         return new Settings(this);
333      }
334   }
335
336   private static final Settings INSTANCE = new Builder()
337      .globalStore(initProperty(DISABLE_GLOBAL_PROP).map(Boolean::valueOf).orElse(false) ? () -> null : MapStore::new)
338      .setSources(RELAXED_SYSTEM_ENV_SOURCE, SYSTEM_PROPERTY_SOURCE)
339      .useServiceLoader()
340      .build();
341
342   /**
343    * Returns the singleton instance of Settings.
344    *
345    * @return The singleton Settings instance.
346    */
347   public static Settings get() {
348      return INSTANCE;
349   }
350
351   private final Memoizer<PropertyStore> globalStore;
352   @SuppressWarnings({
353      "java:S5164" // Cleanup method provided: cleanup()
354   })
355   private final ThreadLocal<PropertyStore> localStore;
356   private final List<PropertySource> sources;
357   private final Map<Class<?>,Function<String,?>> toTypeFunctions;
358
359   /**
360    * Constructor.
361    */
362   private Settings(Builder builder) {
363      this.globalStore = memoizer(builder.globalStoreSupplier);
364      this.localStore = ThreadLocal.withInitial(builder.localStoreSupplier);
365      this.sources = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>(builder.sources);
366      this.toTypeFunctions = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(builder.customTypeFunctions);
367   }
368
369   /**
370    * Adds a property source after this settings instance has been built.
371    *
372    * @param source The property source to add. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
373    * @return This object for method chaining.
374    */
375   public Settings addSource(PropertySource source) {
376      reqnn("source", source);
377      sources.add(source);
378      return this;
379   }
380
381   /**
382    * Returns the number of {@link PropertySource}s currently registered with this
383    * {@code Settings} instance.
384    *
385    * <p>
386    * Intended primarily for tests that need to verify nothing has leaked extra sources into the
387    * process-wide {@link #get() Settings.get()} singleton &mdash; the historical failure mode
388    * documented where a per-{@code RestContext}
389    * config bridge added a {@code ConfigPropertySource} per cached {@code RestContext} via
390    * {@link #addSource(PropertySource)} and never removed it.
391    *
392    * @return The current source count. Always {@code &gt;= 0}.
393    */
394   public int sourceCount() {
395      return sources.size();
396   }
397
398   /**
399    * Removes a previously-added property source.
400    *
401    * <p>
402    * The match is by identity ({@code ==}), not equality.  Callers that mutate the singleton
403    * {@link #get() Settings.get()} from a test should capture the exact reference returned to/passed
404    * into {@link #addSource(PropertySource)} and pass it back here in their teardown to avoid
405    * cross-test bleed.
406    *
407    * @param source The property source to remove. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
408    * @return <jk>true</jk> if the source was present and removed, <jk>false</jk> otherwise.
409    */
410   public boolean removeSource(PropertySource source) {
411      reqnn("source", source);
412      // Identity-based removal so that PropertySource impls without a sensible equals() still
413      // round-trip cleanly through add/remove pairs.
414      for (var i = 0; i < sources.size(); i++) {
415         if (sources.get(i) == source) {
416            sources.remove(i);
417            return true;
418         }
419      }
420      return false;
421   }
422
423   /**
424    * Returns a {@link StringSetting} for the specified system property.
425    *
426    * <p>
427    * The returned {@link StringSetting} is a resettable supplier that caches the lookup result.
428    * Use the {@link StringSetting#asInteger()}, {@link StringSetting#asBoolean()}, etc. methods
429    * to convert to different types.
430    *
431    * <p>
432    * The lookup order is:
433    * <ol>
434    *    <li>Per-thread override (if set via {@link #setLocal(String, String)})
435    *    <li>Global override (if set via {@link #setGlobal(String, String)})
436    *    <li>Sources in reverse order (last source added via {@link Builder#addSource(PropertySource)} is checked first)
437    *    <li>System property source (default, always second-to-last)
438    *    <li>System environment variable source (default, always last)
439    * </ol>
440    *
441    * @param name The property name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
442    * @return A {@link StringSetting} that provides the resolved property value.
443    */
444   public StringSetting get(String name) {
445      reqnn("name", name);
446      return new StringSetting(this, () -> {
447         // 1. Check thread-local override
448         var v = localStore.get().get(name);
449         if (v.isPresent())
450            return v.value().orElse(null); // Present result: Optional.empty() means explicit null override.
451
452         // 2. Check global override
453         v = globalStore.get().get(name);
454         if (v.isPresent())
455            return v.value().orElse(null); // Present result: Optional.empty() means explicit null override.
456
457         // 3. Check sources in reverse order (last added first)
458         for (int i = sources.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
459            var source = sources.get(i);
460            var result = source.get(name);
461            if (result.isPresent())
462               return result.value().orElse(null);
463         }
464
465         return null;
466      });
467   }
468
469   /**
470    * Returns the override value for the specified property, consulting only the per-thread
471    * (local) and global stores &mdash; <i>not</i> the sources list.
472    *
473    * <p>
474    * Intended for callers (notably the {@code @Value} resolution path) that interleave a
475    * caller-scoped property source between the Settings override stores and the sources list.
476    * Using this method, the caller can honor the "{@link #setLocal(String, String) local}
477    * / {@link #setGlobal(String, String) global} override wins" contract before consulting
478    * its own scoped sources, and still fall through to {@link #get(String)} (which checks
479    * the sources list) afterwards without the override stores accidentally being consulted twice.
480    *
481    * <p>
482    * Lookup order honored by this method:
483    * <ol>
484    *    <li>Per-thread (local) store
485    *    <li>Global store
486    * </ol>
487    *
488    * <p>
489    * If a store is present with an empty value (i.e. an explicit null override), the returned
490    * {@link Optional} is {@code Optional.empty()} but {@link #isOverridden(String)} would
491    * return {@code true}. Callers needing to distinguish "absent" from "explicit null" should
492    * use {@link #isOverridden(String)} alongside this method.
493    *
494    * @param name The property name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
495    * @return The override value, or {@link Optional#empty()} if neither store carries an override.
496    * @see #isOverridden(String)
497    * @see #get(String)
498    */
499   public Optional<String> getOverride(String name) {
500      reqnn("name", name);
501      var v = localStore.get().get(name);
502      if (v.isPresent())
503         return v.value();
504      v = globalStore.get().get(name);
505      if (v.isPresent())
506         return v.value();
507      return oe();
508   }
509
510   /**
511    * Returns <jk>true</jk> if the specified property has an override in either the per-thread
512    * (local) or global store.
513    *
514    * <p>
515    * Distinguishes the "explicit null override" case &mdash; where {@link #getOverride(String)}
516    * returns {@link Optional#empty()} because the override value itself was {@code null} &mdash;
517    * from the "no override" case.
518    *
519    * @param name The property name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
520    * @return <jk>true</jk> if either store carries an override (even with a {@code null} value).
521    */
522   public boolean isOverridden(String name) {
523      reqnn("name", name);
524      return localStore.get().get(name).isPresent() || globalStore.get().get(name).isPresent();
525   }
526
527   /**
528    * Looks up a system property, returning a default value if not found.
529    *
530    * <p>
531    * This method searches for a value using the same lookup order as {@link #get(String)}.
532    * If a value is found, it is converted to the type of the default value using {@link #toType(String, Class)}.
533    * Supported types include any type that has a static method with signature <c>public static &lt;T&gt; T anyName(String arg)</c>
534    * or a public constructor with signature <c>public T(String arg)</c>, such as {@link Boolean}, {@link Integer}, {@link Charset}, {@link java.io.File}, etc.
535    *
536    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
537    * <p class='bjava'>
538    *    <jc>// System property: -Dmy.property=true</jc>
539    *    Boolean <jv>flag</jv> = get(<js>"my.property"</js>, <jk>false</jk>);  <jc>// true</jc>
540    *
541    *    <jc>// Environment variable: MY_PROPERTY=UTF-8</jc>
542    *    Charset <jv>charset</jv> = get(<js>"my.property"</js>, Charset.defaultCharset());  <jc>// UTF-8</jc>
543    *
544    *    <jc>// Not found, returns default</jc>
545    *    String <jv>value</jv> = get(<js>"nonexistent"</js>, <js>"default"</js>);  <jc>// "default"</jc>
546    * </p>
547    *
548    * @param <T> The type to convert the value to.
549    * @param name The property name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
550    * @param def The default value to return if not found. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
551    * @return The found value (converted to type T), or the default value if not found.
552    * @see #get(String)
553    * @see #toType(String, Class)
554    */
555   public <T> T get(String name, T def) {
556      reqnn("def", def);
557      return get(name).asType((Class<T>)def.getClass()).orElse(def);
558   }

560   /**
561    * Sets a global override for the specified property.
562    *
563    * <p>
564    * This override will apply to all threads and takes precedence over system properties.
565    * However, per-thread overrides (set via {@link #setLocal(String, String)}) will still take precedence
566    * over global overrides.
567    *
568    * <p>
569    * If the <c>juneau.settings.disableGlobal</c> system property is set to <c>true</c>,
570    * this method will throw an exception. This allows system administrators
571    * to prevent applications from overriding system properties globally.
572    *
573    * <p>
574    * Setting a value to <c>null</c> will store an empty optional, effectively overriding the system
575    * property to return empty. Use {@link #unsetGlobal(String)} to completely remove the override.
576    *
577    * @param name The property name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
578    * @param value The override value, or <c>null</c> to set an empty override.
579    * @return This object for method chaining.
580    * @see #unsetGlobal(String)
581    * @see #clearGlobal()
582    */
583   public Settings setGlobal(String name, String value) {
584      reqnn("name", name);
585      globalStore.orElseThrow(()->isex(MSG_globalDisabled)).set(name, value);
586      return this;
587   }
588
589   /**
590    * Removes a global override for the specified property.
591    *
592    * <p>
593    * After calling this method, the property will fall back to the system property value
594    * (or per-thread override if one exists).
595    *
596    * @param name The property name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
597    * @see #setGlobal(String, String)
598    * @see #clearGlobal()
599    */
600   public void unsetGlobal(String name) {
601      reqnn("name", name);
602      globalStore.orElseThrow(()->isex(MSG_globalDisabled)).unset(name);
603   }
604
605   /**
606    * Sets a per-thread override for the specified property.
607    *
608    * <p>
609    * This override will only apply to the current thread and takes precedence over global overrides
610    * and system properties. This is particularly useful in unit tests where you need to temporarily
611    * change a system property value without affecting other threads or tests.
612    *
613    * <p>
614    * Setting a value to <c>null</c> will store an empty optional, effectively overriding the property
615    * to return empty for this thread. Use {@link #unsetLocal(String)} to completely remove the override.
616    *
617    * @param name The property name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
618    * @param value The override value, or <c>null</c> to set an empty override.
619    * @return This object for method chaining.
620    * @see #unsetLocal(String)
621    * @see #clearLocal()
622    */
623   public Settings setLocal(String name, String value) {
624      reqnn("name", name);
625      chk(nn(localStore.get()), MSG_localDisabled);
626      localStore.get().set(name, value);
627      return this;
628   }
629
630   /**
631    * Removes a per-thread override for the specified property.
632    *
633    * <p>
634    * After calling this method, the property will fall back to the global override (if set)
635    * or the system property value for the current thread.
636    *
637    * @param name The property name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
638    * @see #setLocal(String, String)
639    * @see #clearLocal()
640    */
641   public void unsetLocal(String name) {
642      reqnn("name", name);
643      chk(nn(localStore.get()), MSG_localDisabled);
644      localStore.get().unset(name);
645   }
646
647   /**
648    * Clears all per-thread overrides for the current thread.
649    *
650    * <p>
651    * After calling this method, all properties will fall back to global overrides (if set)
652    * or system property values for the current thread.
653    *
654    * <p>
655    * This is typically called in a <c>@AfterEach</c> or <c>@After</c> test method to clean up
656    * thread-local overrides after a test completes.
657    *
658    * @return This object for method chaining.
659    * @see #setLocal(String, String)
660    * @see #unsetLocal(String)
661    */
662   public Settings clearLocal() {
663      chk(nn(localStore.get()), MSG_localDisabled);
664      localStore.get().clear();
665      return this;
666   }
667
668   /**
669    * Cleans up thread-local storage for the current thread.
670    *
671    * <p>
672    * This method should be called when a thread is finished using this Settings instance to prevent memory leaks
673    * in thread pool environments where threads are reused.
674    */
675   public void cleanup() {
676      if (localStore != null) {
677         localStore.remove();
678      }
679   }
680
681   /**
682    * Clears all global overrides.
683    *
684    * <p>
685    * After calling this method, all properties will fall back to resolver values
686    * (or per-thread overrides if they exist).
687    *
688    * @return This object for method chaining.
689    * @see #setGlobal(String, String)
690    * @see #unsetGlobal(String)
691    */
692   public Settings clearGlobal() {
693      globalStore.orElseThrow(()->isex(MSG_globalDisabled)).clear();
694      return this;
695   }

697   /**
698    * Converts a string to the specified type using reflection to find conversion methods or constructors.
699    *
700    * <p>
701    * This method attempts to convert a string to the specified type using the following lookup order:
702    * <ol>
703    *    <li>Custom type functions registered via {@link Builder#addTypeFunction(Class, Function)}</li>
704    *    <li>Special handling for {@link String} (returns the string as-is)</li>
705    *    <li>Special handling for {@link Enum} types (uses {@link Enum#valueOf(Class, String)})</li>
706    *    <li>Reflection lookup for static methods with signature <c>public static &lt;T&gt; T anyName(String arg)</c>
707    *       on the target class</li>
708    *    <li>Reflection lookup for static methods on the superclass (for abstract classes like {@link Charset}
709    *       where concrete implementations need to use the abstract class's static method)</li>
710    *    <li>Reflection lookup for public constructors with signature <c>public T(String arg)</c></li>
711    * </ol>
712    *
713    * <p>
714    * When a conversion method or constructor is found via reflection, it is cached in the
715    * <c>toTypeFunctions</c> map for future use.
716    *
717    * <h5 class='section'>Examples:</h5>
718    * <ul class='spaced-list'>
719    *    <li><c>Boolean</c> - Uses <c>Boolean.valueOf(String)</c> static method
720    *    <li><c>Integer</c> - Uses <c>Integer.valueOf(String)</c> static method
721    *    <li><c>Charset</c> - Uses <c>Charset.forName(String)</c> static method (even for concrete implementations)
722    *    <li><c>File</c> - Uses <c>File(String)</c> constructor
723    * </ul>
724    *
725    * @param <T> The target type.
726    * @param s The string to convert. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
727    * @param c The target class. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
728    * @return The converted value.
729    * @throws RuntimeException If the type is not supported for conversion (no static method or constructor found).
730    */
731   @SuppressWarnings({
732      "rawtypes" // Raw types necessary for generic type handling
733   })
734   public <T> T toType(String s, Class<T> c) {
735      reqnn("s", s);
736      reqnn("c", c);
737      var f = (Function<String,T>)toTypeFunctions.get(c);
738      if (f == null) {
739         if (c == String.class)
740            return (T)s;
741         if (c.isEnum())
742            return (T)Enum.valueOf((Class<? extends Enum>)c, s);
743         ClassInfoTyped<T> ci = info(c);
744         f = ci.getDeclaredMethod(x -> x.isStatic() && x.hasParameterTypes(String.class) && x.hasReturnType(c) && FROM_STRING_METHOD_NAMES.contains(x.getName())).map(x -> (Function<String,T>)s2 -> x.invoke(null, s2)).orElse(null);
745         // Also accept `static T parse(CharSequence)` etc. — common for java.time types (Instant,
746         // LocalDate, Duration) whose static factories declare the wider CharSequence parameter.
747         if (f == null)
748            f = ci.getDeclaredMethod(x -> x.isStatic() && x.hasParameterTypes(CharSequence.class) && x.hasReturnType(c) && FROM_STRING_METHOD_NAMES.contains(x.getName())).map(x -> (Function<String,T>)s2 -> x.invoke(null, s2)).orElse(null);
749         if (f == null)
750            f = ci.getPublicConstructor(x -> x.hasParameterTypes(String.class)).map(x -> (Function<String,T>)x::newInstance).orElse(null);
751         if (f != null)
752            toTypeFunctions.putIfAbsent(c, f);
753      }
754      if (f == null)
755         throw rex("Invalid env type: %s", c);
756      return f.apply(s);
757   }
758}
